description: This file implements credential caching functionality for Git, utilizing UNIX sockets for inter-process communication. It includes functions to connect, spawn, and communicate with a credential cache daemon, handle socket paths, and process commands such as get, store, and erase credentials.

classes.name: struct credential
classes.description: Structure representing credential data, including capabilities and request flags.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Structure for managing child process execution parameters and handles.

methods.name: int connection_closed(int error)
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates that the connection was closed.

methods.name: int connection_fatally_broken(int error)
methods.description: Determines if an error signifies a fatal connection break.

methods.name: int send_request(const char * socket,const struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Sends a request over a UNIX socket and handles the response.

methods.name: void spawn_daemon(const char * socket)
methods.description: Starts the credential cache daemon process.

methods.name: void do_cache(const char * socket,const char * action,int timeout,int flags)
methods.description: Performs cache actions like get, store, or erase by communicating with the daemon.

methods.name: char * get_socket_path(void)
methods.description: Generates the socket file path based on user directories or defaults.

methods.name: void announce_capabilities(void)
methods.description: Announces credential capabilities to external systems.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_cache(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command handler for the credential cache subsystem, dispatching based on arguments.
